objective: Follow-up to ticket A (B310; G17 with G1). On starts whose repeated release is already proved or excluded, read the operator test at every stage. Stop at a proved source that passes at every stage, or at every proved source failing with the number of passing funded starts reported.
status: Computed, referee pending. Failing the operator test is not tied to being a source. Among the 53 single edits of the seven-knot source and 192 supplied draws on nine to twelve knots, all 226 starts with any birth fail at parent step 1 under both laws, including 182 of 182 growing starts not proved to be sources; the 19 that stall at once pass. All 21 proved sources fail (five independent by tree). By the reading fixed before the run the test tracks growth in these populations and no argument is attempted.
title: Does repeated release need a failing pattern?
